latest_release.body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at main -->

## What's Changed
### Major Changes 🛠
* Build project with pyproject.toml by @Armavica in https://github.com/pymc-devs/pymc/pull/8011
* Modernize find_MAP by @velochy in https://github.com/pymc-devs/pymc/pull/8429
### New Features 🎉
* Add Pareto to pymc.dims by @williambdean in https://github.com/pymc-devs/pymc/pull/8422
* Add Neumann and mixed boundary conditions to HSGP by @juanitorduz in https://github.com/pymc-devs/pymc/pull/8433
* Add more distributions to pymc.dims by @williambdean in https://github.com/pymc-devs/pymc/pull/8487
### Bugfixes 🪲
* Respect sample dims in `apply_function_over_dataset` by @ricardoV94 in https://github.com/pymc-devs/pymc/pull/8426
* Make ZeroSumNormal zero-sum check tolerance dtype-aware by @velochy in https://github.com/pymc-devs/pymc/pull/8464
* Fix dims coercion to list in model_from_fgraph by @williambdean in https://github.com/pymc-devs/pymc/pull/8465
* Fix DiscreteUniform.logcdf at the lower bound by @anishmehta24 in https://github.com/pymc-devs/pymc/pull/8452
* Fix LKJ (corr and cov) forward sampling for n>2, and log density normalization by @tjburch in https://github.com/pymc-devs/pymc/pull/8497
* Fix dataset-to-point conversion with no sample dimensions by @j45856021-dev in https://github.com/pymc-devs/pymc/pull/8490
### Documentation 📖
* Update architecture guide by @abhioverdue in https://github.com/pymc-devs/pymc/pull/8475
### Maintenance 🔧
* Slice sampler: cap expansion steps per dimension by @ricardoV94 in https://github.com/pymc-devs/pymc/pull/8420
* Better support for pm.fit(..., backend="jax") by @hrideymarwah15 in https://github.com/pymc-devs/pymc/pull/8472
* Improve VonMises logp overflow for large kappa by @spicysharkco in https://github.com/pymc-devs/pymc/pull/8503
* Small cleanups and bug fixes by @ricardoV94 in https://github.com/pymc-devs/pymc/pull/8522
* Update to pytensor 3.3.5 and better-optimize 0.5, and clear deprecations by @jessegrabowski in https://github.com/pymc-devs/pymc/pull/8584

## New Contributors
* @anurag-mds made their first contribution in https://github.com/pymc-devs/pymc/pull/8430
* @ZainnQureshii made their first contribution in https://github.com/pymc-devs/pymc/pull/8456
* @SatvikMishra08 made their first contribution in https://github.com/pymc-devs/pymc/pull/8474
* @abhioverdue made their first contribution in https://github.com/pymc-devs/pymc/pull/8475
* @anishmehta24 made their first contribution in https://github.com/pymc-devs/pymc/pull/8452
* @hrideymarwah15 made their first contribution in https://github.com/pymc-devs/pymc/pull/8472
* @spicysharkco made their first contribution in https://github.com/pymc-devs/pymc/pull/8503
* @j45856021-dev made their first contribution in https://github.com/pymc-devs/pymc/pull/8490

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pymc-devs/pymc/compare/v6.3.2...v6.4.0
